captions.detailed: A standalone garden bell post featuring a slim, dark-colored square steel post on a square base, with a horizontal cross-arm near the top capped by a spherical finial. A conical bronze-colored bell hangs from a clevis bracket at the center of the cross-arm, supported by a horizontal revolute hinge. Inside the bell, a clapper lever with an attached pull-cord is mounted on a secondary revolute pin to allow realistic swinging and ringing motions.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a garden bell post in CadQuery. The model should include a square base, a tall square vertical post with a decorative top finial, and a horizontal cross-arm. Hang a conical bronze bell from a clevis mount on the cross-arm using a revolute joint, and include an internal clapper lever with a pull-cord on a secondary revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main post, base, cross-arm, and top finial using Box and Sphere primitives combined via translation transforms. Model the hanging clevis bracket and the conical bell shape by revolving or lofting circular profiles, and construct the internal clapper lever using a thin cylinder. Define two revolute joints: one for the bell swinging relative to the cross-arm clevis, and another for the clapper lever rotating inside the bell.
